conditions.field.left.tip: Interpolated text (accepts {{VAR}} from env/parameters and dynamic tokens like {{$timestamp}}). E.g.: {{TOKEN}}, {{EXPIRES_AT}}.

settings.title: Global Settings
settings.window.auto_hide.tip: Launcher behavior: clicking outside hides Kai to the tray, so the global shortcut always brings it back with a single press. Requires a system tray.
settings.window.start_visible.tip: Decides visibility when Kai opens, without depending on the global shortcut: on, always visible; off, always hidden (tray only). On by default (more predictable — global shortcut registration can fail for reasons outside the user's control, e.g. a WSL/WSLg environment or a collision with another app already using the same combination). Reopening with it off is still possible via the tray icon or `kai show` (CLI).

welcome.title: Welcome to Kai
welcome.subtitle: Kai is a native command runner for developers: it runs Shell scripts and HTTP requests, chains automations (hooks), injects per-environment variables — all with a global shortcut and low resource usage.

welcome.getstarted.step3.title: Use dynamic parameters
welcome.getstarted.step3.body: Type {{key}} in any command/URL/body field and pick from the available variables — filled via a form when you run, or coming from an Environment.
